step1.hint: You'll find the bootstrap token once in ModuLab Core's startup log.
step1.label: Bootstrap Token

step2.hint: Enter your OIDC provider's details. ModuLab Core talks to any standard OIDC provider the same way (Pocket ID, Authentik, Keycloak, Authelia, or anything else that speaks OIDC).

step3.hint: Required for automatic TLS certificates via Traefik/Let's Encrypt.

step4.groups_intro: Create these three groups in your OIDC provider and assign your account to the super-admin group before continuing:

step5.hint: Log in now with your OIDC account to bind it as super-admin.
step5.not_super_admin: This user is not a member of the super-admin group. Please assign it in your OIDC provider and log in again.

step6.hint: Optional: outbound mail for account notifications (approved, locked, unlocked). Skip this and set it up later from Admin → SMTP any time, or fill it in now.
step6.validation_error: Host, port, and from address are all required - or use Skip below.

step7.hint: Last step: permanently disable the bootstrap token.
step7.done_message: Setup complete. ModuLab Core is now in normal operation.
